#include "shared.h"

void FUN_000b88f0(LowpassFilter &filter, double cutoffFrequency) {
    float sampleRate = 44100.0f;
    float dt = 1.0f / sampleRate;

    for (int i = 0; i < filter.bufferSize; ++i) {
        float currentSample = filter.inputBuffer[i];
        float previousSample = i > 0 ? filter.outputBuffer[i - 1] : 0.0f;
        float filteredSample = previousSample + (currentSample - previousSample) * dt / cutoffFrequency;
        filter.outputBuffer[i] = filteredSample;
    }

    std::copy(filter.outputBuffer, filter.outputBuffer + filter.bufferSize, filter.inputBuffer);
}
```

#include "shared.h"

float FUN_000b9cb8(float input, LowpassFilter* filter) {
    float alpha = 1.0f / (filter->sampleRate * filter->cutoffFrequency);
    float output = alpha * input + (1.0f - alpha) * filter->lastSample;
    filter->lastSample = output;
    return output;
}

void FUN_00175e98(BitmapContext *context, const std::vector<float> &lowpassKernel) {

#include "shared.h"

float FUN_00076bb0(const vector<AudioFrame>& frames, float cutoffFrequency) {
    const float sampleRate = 44100.0f;
    const float alpha = 2 * M_PI * cutoffFrequency / sampleRate;

    vector<float> filteredSamples;
    for (const auto& frame : frames) {
        float filteredSample = 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
            filteredSample += alpha * frame.sample[i] + (1.0f - alpha) * filteredSamples.back();
        }
        filteredSamples.push_back(filteredSample);
    }

    return filteredSamples[0];
}
```
